scope: S3 short mixed run 20261028-213330; raw Collector vs AgentSight, not production AnySentry. Post-hoc task-related program selection, not independent complete kernel ground truth.
definition: Direct dependency installation commands, task object construction/configuration, core programs and their task subprocesses, validation and output-location programs. Exclude sleep/gate/hook/shell initialization, generic shell/runuser wrappers, and package-manager internals. Include task failure/retry with actual exec, not only successful commands.

other_selectors.crack: apt-get; actual perl running 7z2john (two attempts); john; /usr/lib/7zip/7z; rg PID971540 with cwd /app/extracted

notes: Interpreter/env wrappers normalized to the actual selected program; not counted twice.
Read/Edit/Write within the Kimi process need not create exec. Native tool logs are not kernel file I/O proof.
Selected web PIDs implement explicit task user/directory/permission checks plus temporary validation workspace creation and permission preparation.
The full raw family archive includes one additional pre-window root gate exec per task. It is excluded from key selection; existing total columns retain the original window counts.
No new workload or runtime modification.
Recount excludes temporary directory cleanup, Git maintenance and automatic gc from task-critical counts; these remain in total event counts.
